paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
heading: Toupa'n Aigupta Gawt Ding

paite: "Mihing tapa, thu gen inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi.
"Kikou un, maizen! Maizen, tua ni tel; ni anai hi, TOUPA ni anai hi, mei kai ni, pau tuam mite siatna ding.
Ahong tung ding, namsau, Aigupta tung ah; sinlai natna, Ethiopia tung ah, Aigupta ah mithah apuk un; athil hauh ziazuate alamang ding ua, asuangphumte achimse ding."
"Ethiopia, Pud leh Lud, nam chih omkhawm, Kush leh gam tate tel teite tengteng, namsau in apuk ding uh.”
"TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Aigupta tungding mite leng apuk ding ua, ahatna suanpen uh leng avuallel ding; Migdol a kipan Suene pha in namsau in apuk ding uh, Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
Gam hihgawpsate lak a khat ahi ding a, akhopite leng khopi gawpsate lak a ahi mai ding uh.
Aigupta gam ah mei ka khah ding a, amau panpih mite tengteng ka hihsiat hun chiang in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.”

Huai ni chiang in Ethiopia mi kigingloute lunglelsak ding in ka kiang a kipan mi sawl long in apai ding ua; Aigupta ni mah bang in lungtang mangbatna mahmah atung uah atung sam ding hi; ngai in, ahong tung lellel hi.
"Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut in Aigupta thil hauh ziazuate ka hihmang ding.
Gam hihse ding in amah leh alawite, namte lak a kihtakte tunsak ahi ding uh; Aigupta tung ah anamsau uh alik ding ua, misi luang in gam adimsak ding uh.
Huan luipite ka kangsak ding a, migiloute kiang ah gam ka khawng ding; agam leh asung a om tengteng pau tuam mite khut in ka hihgawp ding; kei TOUPA'N ka chita ahi.
"Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Milimte ka hihse ding a, Memphis a kipan milimte ka hihmang ding, Aigupta ah heutu a-omta kei ding uh; huchi in Aigupta gam ah launa ka omsak ding.
"Pathros ka hihgawp ding a, Zoan ah mei ka khah dia; Thebes ah ka tangtungsak ding.
Huan Aigupta kulh Sin tung ah ka hehna ka lungdamsak ding a, Thebes a mipite ka phukmang ding.
Huan Aigupta ah mei ka khah ding a, buaitak in Sin a-om ding a, Thebes leng achim vek ding; Memphis in sun chiang in melma anei nilouh ding hi.
Aven leh Pibeseth kho tangvalte namsau in apuk ding ua, huai khuate sal a pi in a-om ding uh.
Aigupta hakkol ka hihtan a, ahatna akisaktheihpih ka hihbei hun Tehphanhes ah ni amial ding; amah zaw meipi in aliah ding a, atanute sal a pi in a-om ding uh.
Hichibang in Aigupta gam ah thu ka tangtungsak ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," chi in.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum sawm-le-khatna, akha khatna, huai kha ani sagih ni in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
heading: Aigupta Kumpipa Thilhihtheihna Kisia

paite: "Mihing tapa, Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh ban ka kitansak a, ngai in, namsau tawi ding ahat nawnna ding in damdawi nuh leh tuam aloh kei hi.
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai in Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh ka dou ahi, aban hoih lam leh akitansa nunglam leng ka kitansak ding a; huchi in akhut a kipan namsau ka kitansak ding hi.
Aigupta mite namte lak ah ka dalhsak ding a, gam chih ah ka thelthangsak ding.
Babulon kumpipa bante ka hatsak ding a, akhut ah namsau ka tawisak ding a; Pharaoh bante ka kitansak ding a, ama ah sihpih khop liam mau in amau ding hi.

Huchi in Babulon kumpipa bante ka hatsak ding a, Pharaoh bante bel aluaikhe ding; Babulon kumpipa khut ah ka namsau ka tawisak a, Aigupta kumpipa tung a alik hun chiang in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
Aigupta mite namte lak ah ka dalhsak ding a, gam chih ah ka thelthangsak vek ding; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," chi in.
